decisions.reason: The battery-life objective does not change the existing AXP2101 thermal-pad cooling requirement.
Battery efficiency does not modify the specified overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal protection behavior.
The source does not change the panel button connector, signal, location, or switching behavior.
The battery-life objective does not resolve or alter the battery connector family, contacts, or pinout.
No DCDC1 voltage, current, source role, or compensation setting is changed by the general efficiency objective.
The source concerns efficient battery operation and does not change the USB-only standalone power path or resolve its regulator-capacity ambiguity.
The existing switched-rail settings remain valid; the source supplies no new GPIO, shutdown, load, or operating-pattern rule.
Maximizing battery life does not change the charge-status LED, connector, resistor, or population requirements.
The general battery-life objective is compatible with the existing low-power policy but does not specify a new sleep mode, wake condition, interval, or current target.
The efficiency objective does not alter which rails are monitored, monitor placement, coverage, or spare-channel count.
Battery efficiency is unrelated to the retained TVS ESD protection requirement.
The source constrains power-management efficiency within the design but does not change the selected board variants, their roles, connector architecture, or cost-reduction goal.
